method.important_boundary: This review records source-lineage and readiness gaps only. It does not compile the ledger into canonical Plans.

overall_verdict.objective_summary: The ledger has accepted atoms and answered product questions, but the new miscellaneous items are not all represented in canonical owner docs with behavior, GUI, storage, command/wiring, security, and validation coverage.
overall_verdict.subjective_summary: I would not hand the whole bundle to an implementer as ready-to-build from Plans alone. I would hand it to a compiler/spec editor as a strong source packet with explicit gaps to close before implementation.

gaps: No dedicated visualizer readiness matrix exists yet.
Canonical Plans do not yet define the PM-native streaming marker/feed and incremental reconciliation contract.
Accepted bridge aliases copyText, toast, saveState, and loadState are not reconciled with canonical bridge names such as copyToClipboard and requestResize.
Accepted token/UI deltas such as nine color ramps, data-accent, aria-invalid, focus-visible, localized feedback, and audio-off default are not canonicalized.
Expanded library candidates Vega-Lite, ECharts, Plotly, and vis-network are ledger-only and not versioned allowlist entries in Plans.
Visualizer-specific automated tests are not canonicalized.

Slack, Discord, generic webhook, ntfy, Pushover, and Telegram destination contracts lack canonical payload templates, required fields, auth modes, retry/backoff, rate-limit handling, and receipt shapes.
Notifications/Sounds settings surface lacks canonical placement, field list, empty/error/disabled states, test-send interaction model, command IDs, and wiring rows.
Global default plus per-project override storage and inheritance rules are accepted but not canonicalized.
Uploaded/custom sounds lack canonical max size, duration, format normalization/transcoding, duplicate handling, manifest, deletion/restore, and export behavior.
Built-in normal notification sound catalog, naming, categories, licensing/source rule, and default event mappings are not specified.
PeonPing/OpenPeon compatibility needs a manifest mapping and unsupported/unknown sound behavior.
Destination-specific delivery tests and redaction/no-secret proof are not canonicalized.
